blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The House prosecution panel in Vice President Sara Duterte’s impeachment trial did not go on a “fishing expedition” as its evidence came from her own records, along with those of her husband, lawyer Manases Carpio, and their alleged companies. Rep. Gerville Luistro, the lead prosecutor, made this denial on Wednesday in an interview with ANC, tracing the evidence against the vice president to corporate filings, tax returns, bank reports, and official registrations of firearms and properties. “All of the pieces of evidence used for the unexplained wealth [charge] are the own documents of the respondent, her husband, and […]... Keep on reading: Luistro: No ‘fishing expedition’ in wealth case vs VP Duterte
